aiOperationsIntro: Manage AI connections, execution models, and feature defaults for this Tower installation. Unless noted otherwise, changes apply server-wide.
modelsIntro: Manage the models available in this Tower installation and their execution status.
accountsIntro: Manage legacy direct accounts and project config assignments.
legacyExecutionIntro: Only needed for installations that still use Claude CLI config directories or project-level account assignment. No changes are needed when AI Router is the only path.
name: Name
modelPolicyIntro: Choose the default model for each type of work.
modelPolicyApplyHint: Changes apply to subsequent runs. Work that is already running keeps its current model.
aiStatusReady: All default execution paths are ready.
aiStatusNeedsSetup: Check the AI Provider connection or default model configuration.
connectionsAndAuthIntro: Check the server-wide AI Provider connection. Manage project-specific external service accounts in Connections.
availableModelsIntro: Models that users can select or assign to an execution policy. Technical details remain available in each model row.
legacyModelsHint: Used only by legacy direct execution
systemDiagnosticsIntro: Useful diagnostics for incident reports, deploy checks, and environment verification.
usageDescription: AI token input/output, estimated cost, and remaining budget for this VM. Manage customer-wide budgets in the LiteLLM admin page.
composerDescription: Control AI suggestions shown while composing messages. This uses the fast utility model and applies server-wide.
composerSavedHint: Changes apply to this tab immediately and to other tabs within 30 seconds.
recentTokenUsage: Token usage over the last {{days}} days
budgetRemaining: Remaining LiteLLM key budget for this VM
noTokenBudget: No AI token budget to display.
budgetLookupFailed: Failed to retrieve AI token budget.
agentManagementIntro: Review retired and recoverable agents and preview the impact of permanent deletion. This screen does not delete anything.
permanentDeletionWarning: This permanently deletes conversations, files, and dedicated credentials and cannot be undone.
deletionProgress: Job {{id}} · Status {{status}}. Refreshing automatically until complete, failed, or recovery required.
confirmAgentName: Enter the agent name {{name}} to confirm.
understandPermanentDeletion: I understand that conversations, files, Runtime, and agent-only credentials will be permanently deleted.
label: Label
unassignedHint: Unassigned projects use the default account:
usernameAndPasswordRequired: User ID and password are required
passwordMin8Chars: Password must be at least 8 characters
accountFieldsRequired: ID, Label and Config Dir are required
deleteAccountConfirm: Delete account "{{id}}"? Projects using it will fall back to the default.
promptEditorIntro: This prompt is injected at the start of every conversation. It sets team-wide rules and behavior.
promptEditorTip: Tip: Use Cmd/Ctrl+S to save quickly. Role-specific context (user name, role, workspace path) is appended automatically.
promptHowItWorks: Every conversation gets this system prompt + auto-appended user context:
sessionModelDesc: Used by default for new conversations and medium-to-complex agent work.
aiReplyModelDesc: Used for titles, summaries, composer suggestions, inline edits, and other short internal AI work.
taskExecutionModelDesc: Used for scheduled runs, asynchronous tasks, Skill Workbench, and other background work.
modelSaveFailed: Could not save AI execution settings.
defaultModelDisableBlocked: A model used by the default execution policy cannot be disabled. Select a different model in Execution Model Policy first.
defaultModelDeleteBlocked: A model used by the default execution policy cannot be deleted. Select a different model in Execution Model Policy first.
noAccountsHint: No accounts registered. All sessions use default
unassignedHintFull: Unassigned projects use the default account:
editUserSubtitle: Name and affiliation can also be edited by the user. User ID is used for login and audit logs, and can only be changed by an admin.
renameUserConfirm:
Change "{{old}}" → "{{new}}"?

The user will be signed out on all devices and must log in again with the new User ID.
Permissions, sessions, and existing work are preserved.
userOnboardingIntro: Create the user first, choose a global role, then grant real workspace access by inviting them to projects. Per-user work directories are no longer configured here.
onboardingIdentityDesc: Set display name, affiliation, User ID, and initial password.
onboardingRoleDesc: Choose whether this is an admin/operator or a normal member/viewer.
onboardingProjectInviteDesc: A member's actual file access is determined by project membership.
accessDerivedFromRoleAndProjects: Derived from role and project membership
accessDerivedHint: At signup, set only the account and global role. Grant project access from the project menu's invite/member management.
accessWorkspaceWideDesc: Admin/operator roles can work across the whole workspace.
accessProjectBasedDesc: Works only inside invited projects. Add members from the project menu.

health.oauthTokenNoReveal: OAuth tokens are not shown in plain text. Reconnect the service if there is a problem.
health.sshKeyNoReveal: SSH private keys are not shown in plain text. Use the replacement flow if verification is needed.
health.structuredNoReveal: Structured credentials can be inspected only for non-sensitive structure.

readiness.readyDescription: The project connection and provider authentication are both verified.
readiness.invalidDescription: Stored authentication is invalid and must be replaced.
readiness.reauthDescription: The stored login expired or was revoked. Reconnect the service.
readiness.degradedDescription: The connection remains active, but some features need verification.
readiness.connectedUnverifiedDescription: The project is connected, but provider authentication has not been verified.
readiness.unusedDescription: This connection is not currently enabled.

credentialConnections.agentConnectionDescription: Manage which agents can use this connection. Changes require an impact preview and admin approval.
credentialConnections.dedicatedCredential: Dedicated credential cannot be shared with another agent
credentialConnections.diagnosticDescription: Stored credentials, project permissions, and provider authentication are separate states.

purpose.openai: Used for image generation, slide creation, and AI-powered content production.
purpose.firecrawl: Used to read web pages, search the web, and collect research.
purpose.apify: Used for external crawling tasks such as fetching YouTube transcripts.
purpose.naver: Used for news, blog, and web searches through the Naver Search API.
purpose.google: Accesses Google Workspace data. Project-specific access is safer for personal or organizational data.
purpose.ssh: A key that can access servers. Enabling it by default for every project is risky.
purpose.aligo: Used to send text messages. Project-specific access is safer because of cost and accidental-send risk.
purpose.default: A connection used to access an external service.

usageScope.allProjects: Enabled by default for all projects
usageScope.none: Not used by any project yet

warning.inherited: Enabled by default in {{count}} projects. This describes the impact scope, not a problem.
warning.disabledPolicies: Policy rows remain in {{count}} projects, but the connection itself is disabled.

credentialConnections.personalDescription: Connect your external accounts and control which project AI teammates may use them when handling your requests. Your Credential is not shared when other people use the same project AI teammate.
credentialConnections.adminDescription: Connect the external services used by Tower and its projects, and review their status in one place. A connection is shown as available only after authentication is verified.
credentialConnections.personalPrivacyDescription: API keys and login values are never shown on screen or in chat. Only teammates and Helpers in allowed projects may use them in runs you start. Technical settings are available in advanced management when needed.
credentialConnections.adminPrivacyDescription: Review the service name, purpose, current status, and next action. Technical settings such as Credential IDs and Runtime environment names stay in advanced management.
credentialConnections.googleOauthSetupRequired: Google OAuth must be configured on this Tower server.
credentialConnections.errorDiagnosticHint: If the list is empty or unclear, send the prompt below to the operator AI to diagnose the status first.
credentialConnections.googleAccountDescription: This is your account for Google Mail, Calendar, and Drive. Once connected, Tower loads it securely when needed.
credentialConnections.googleOauthNotConfigured: Google OAuth is not configured on this Tower server yet. An operator must register an OAuth client and this domain’s callback URI.
credentialConnections.googleLoginExpired: The saved login expired or was revoked by Google.
credentialConnections.tokenRefreshFailed: Token refresh verification failed · Reconnecting will replace it.
credentialConnections.askAiDescription: Explain whether each service is actually available and what to do if there is a problem, based on Connection status. Secret values and technical identifiers are excluded from the conversation.
credentialConnections.addApiKeyPrompt: Prompt for adding a new API key
credentialConnections.noSecretsIncluded: The content below does not include secret values.
credentialConnections.serviceConnectionsDescription: Check where each service is used and whether it is actually available. Technical settings are handled only in advanced management.
credentialConnections.authNotChecked: Actual authentication has not been checked yet.
credentialConnections.basicManagementDescription: Manage renaming, account reconnection, safe disconnection, and restoration.
credentialConnections.adminSummary: {{connections}} registered connections · {{defaults}} default for all projects
credentialConnections.privateProjectOnly: Values hidden · Connected only to my projects
credentialConnections.personalWorkspacesTitle: AI workspaces that can use my Credentials
credentialConnections.personalWorkspacesDescription: When you allow a project, its Primary AI teammate and Helper Agents may use this Credential only while handling requests you start.
credentialConnections.allowedProjectAgents: Teammates and Helpers in allowed projects
credentialConnections.personalCredentialBoundary: This personal Credential is not automatically passed to other project members, other users’ sessions, or externally deployed AI Services. Its actual value is never shown on screen or in chat.
credentialConnections.addPersonalConnectionFirst: First add a personal API key or login account under Connections and status.
credentialConnections.pendingChanges: {{count}} unsaved changes. Save them to apply the actual Runtime Box permissions.
credentialConnections.disconnectConfirmMessage: {{count}} Agents using {{name}} will immediately lose access to this Connection.\n\nThe encrypted value and Agent allow/deny policies are preserved for recovery.

inferenceWizard.title: Connect an AI provider
inferenceWizard.description: Connect a server-wide API Provider. Saving and activating applies the entered model to all three default execution policies.
inferenceWizard.secretHint: The key is encrypted in Tower Credential Vault. It is never written to the model configuration file or returned by the API.
inferenceWizard.setupComplete: Provider connected and set as the default for new sessions.
